item.title: Rate limiter follow-ups: construct before evicting; add two missing tests
item.brief: Follow-up to the rate limiter in ratelimit.py (commit 1811cb5), checked against SPEC.md. (1) KeyedLimiter._bucket_for evicts the least-recently-used key before constructing the new bucket, so a failed construction (for example a NaN clock) drops a tracked key. Construct the new bucket first, then evict and insert. (2) Add a test that a rejected try_acquire(n) with insufficient tokens consumes nothing. (3) Add a test that wait_time leaves the token count unchanged when tokens are available. Use the standard library only. Keep the change minimal, and commit when done.

item.title: Implement rate limiter per SPEC.md in ratelimit.py
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter described in SPEC.md in ratelimit.py, replacing the current stubs. Follow the spec exactly, including its error cases and edge cases (for example: a clock that goes backwards changes nothing until it passes the latest time already seen; KeyedLimiter's max_keys bound). The existing tests in test_ratelimit.py only cover the basics; add tests for the error and edge cases the spec describes. Use the Python standard library only, no new dependencies. Keep functions short, validate inputs at the boundary with clear errors, and do not fail silently. Commit the work when done.

state.summary:

pr.body: Approach: TokenBucket tracks tokens and last-seen clock time; refill credits only time past the latest seen value. KeyedLimiter keeps an OrderedDict of per-key buckets with LRU eviction bounded by max_keys; try_acquire and wait_time both count as use. Inputs are validated at the boundary (TypeError for wrong types, ValueError for out-of-range or non-finite values). Key files: ratelimit.py, test_ratelimit.py. Checks: python3 -m unittest test_ratelimit -> 22 tests OK. Review: agt_01M8AFPG7QD6MX0G0RNFAXSNFS pass, no blocking findings. Follow-ups: construct the new bucket before evicting; add tests for insufficient-token try_acquire and non-consuming wait_time.
pr.summary: Made rate limiting available: TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter now work per SPEC.md. Before: all methods raised NotImplementedError. Now: buckets start full, refill continuously up to capacity, ignore clock regressions, and KeyedLimiter evicts least-recently-used keys beyond max_keys.
pr.title: Implement token-bucket and keyed rate limiter per SPEC.md
